title: TEXAS: TetraEther indeX of Ammonia oxidizerS (texas-psm)
description:
TEXAS (TetraEther indeX of Ammonia oxidizerS; texas-psm) is a Python package that implements a Bayesian proxy system model for TEX86 paleothermometry, calibrating marine isoGDGT distributions against temperature and environmental predictors with Stan. It implements a two-stage workflow:

  1. Forward calibration: Fit a generalized logistic curve (temperature → Scaled Ring Index) to culture, mesocosm, and coretop isoGDGT data using hierarchical Bayesian Stan models. Outputs a compressed posterior .nc file.
  2. Inverse reconstruction (invT): Predict paleotemperatures from new Scaled Ring Index observations by marginalising over posterior parameter draws. Returns a full posterior temperature distribution per sample.

Optional nonthermal predictors (GDGT-2/GDGT-3 ratio and nitrate concentration) are supported. The package ships the seven Stan models the manuscript runs: three forward calibrations, three marginal inverse models, and a linear reference. Superseded and exploratory models are kept in the repository's archive/ directory rather than shipped.
